title: Largest facet capsule principal strains and intervertebral angles at 40 mm T12 displacement

quantity.name: capsule strain
quantity.definition: largest mean in-plane principal strain of the facet capsule (E1 maximum/tensile, E2 minimum) at 40 mm T12 displacement, as reported in text and Table 1 (strain as fraction: 0.146 = 14.6%); and maximum mean IVA per level (Table 1). Means over 7 specimens

source.authors: Ianuzzi A, Little JS, Chiu JB, Baitner A, Kawchuk G, Khalsa PS
source.sample: 7 unembalmed human ligamentous lumbar spines T12-sacrum, superficial tissue incl. multifidus insertions removed, capsules intact

protocol.summary: DISPLACEMENT-CONTROLLED (not pure moment): sacrum potted in epoxy with L3/L4 endplates horizontal; horizontal displacement of T12 by 10, 20, 30, 40 mm at 10 mm/s via a linear actuator coupled through a force transducer and U-shaped collar (no moment at the point of application); flexion, extension, left and right bending; 10 cycles per trial, 3 min recovery between trials; L5-S1 moments kept < 10 Nm (max mean joint moment -4.8 Nm extension, 2.8 Nm flexion at L5-S1). IVA by biaxial inclinometers on adjacent vertebral bodies; capsule plane strains from 3x3 (or 3x2) IR marker arrays (1.16 mm radius) tracked by 2 CCD cameras, 3D-corrected 2D isoparametric method; principal strains organised as maximum (E1, positive) and minimum (E2, negative).
how_to_simulate: Fix the sacrum; apply a horizontal force at T12 (no moment at the application point) so that T12 translates 40 mm anteriorly (flexion), posteriorly (extension) or laterally (left/right bending)
Report intervertebral angle at each level (L1-L2 ... L5-S1) and facet capsule surface maximum/minimum principal strains (Lagrangian, in-plane) on the left and right capsules
protocol.notes: Mean strains vs displacement per level and side are in Figs 6-7 and IVA/moment vs displacement in Figs 3-5; these overlapping-marker line plots were not digitised in this pass. SDs at each displacement are tabulated inside Figs 6-7. Capsules appeared preloaded in neutral; negative E2 interpreted as relaxation, not compression.

data.note: text; Table 1 lists RB 0.086 for L3-L4 (different capsule/side); both kept as printed

data.quantity: max IVA (deg), Table 1; text gives 6.6 deg max LB at L3-L4
mean joint moment (Nm), Fig 5 caption; IVA 4.7 deg

extraction.from: Results text pp.146-149; Table 1; Fig 5 caption
extraction.uncertainty: exact as printed; values are means at the largest displacement, no SD given with them
extraction.check_notes: All values re-read from text/Table 1. Inconsistencies kept as printed: Table 1 L3-L4 max IVA RB -6.0 vs Discussion 'maximum IVA during lateral bending at L3-L4 (6.6 degrees)'; Fig 5 caption IVA 4.7 at L5-S1 extension vs Table 1 5.18.

pass_rule.rule: indicative: model capsule principal strain of correct sign and within +-50% of the reported mean at matched IVA
